Field/Scenario: Create new Flexi RD account with initial deposit ledger row
Preconditions: User logged in
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to iWISH / Flexi RD module (custom controller). 2. Click Add. 3. Fill bankName, accountNumber, targetMaturityDate. 4. Add one deposit ledger row (date + amount). 5. Save.
Test Data: bankName=Kotak Mahindra Bank; accountNumber=FLX8877665; targetMaturityDate=2027-01-01; ledger row: date=2026-01-01, amount=10000
Expected Result: Record saves successfully; totalDeposited equals the single ledger row amount (10000); currentValue computed via flexiRdValue.

Field/Scenario: Add an additional deposit ledger row to existing Flexi RD
Preconditions: An existing Flexi RD with one ledger row (10000 on 2026-01-01) exists
Test Steps: 1. Open existing record. 2. Add a second ledger row. 3. Save.
Expected Result: Record updates; totalDeposited becomes 25000 (sum of both rows); currentValue recalculated including accrued interest on both entries.

Field/Scenario: Edit an existing ledger row's amount and date
Preconditions: A Flexi RD with two ledger rows exists
Test Steps: 1. Open record. 2. Edit the second ledger row's amount from 15000 to 20000. 3. Save.
Expected Result: Ledger row updates; totalDeposited recalculated to reflect new sum (30000); currentValue recomputed.

Field/Scenario: Delete a ledger row and verify running total recalculates
Preconditions: A Flexi RD with two ledger rows (10000 and 20000) exists
Test Steps: 1. Open record. 2. Delete the second ledger row. 3. Save.
Expected Result: totalDeposited reverts to 10000 (only the remaining row); currentValue recalculated to reflect only the remaining deposit's accrued value.

Field/Scenario: Delete entire Flexi RD record
Preconditions: An existing Flexi RD record exists
Test Steps: 1. Open record. 2. Click Delete on the whole account. 3. Confirm.
Test Data: Existing Kotak Mahindra Bank Flexi RD
Expected Result: Entire record and all its ledger rows are removed; record no longer appears in list view.
